reasoning: The agent patch correctly implements the core requirement of making merchant_category_code optional for the Click to Pay Visa flow. It changes the type from String to Option<String> in both the API models (crates/api_models/src/payments.rs) and domain models (crates/hyperswitch_domain_models/src/payments.rs), which allows session token generation to succeed when the field is omitted. It also correctly updates all three connector configuration TOML files (development, production, sandbox) to set required=false, enabling merchants to configure the connector without providing this field. The approach is functionally equivalent to the reference patch. The main deficiency is the inclusion of an unrelated .omo session continuation metadata file (.omo/run-continuation/ses_13993539fffeCK2AU6uZkpatP8.json) which has no business being in the diff. Additionally, the agent patch omits the OpenAPI specification regeneration (api-reference/v1/openapi_spec_v1.json and api-reference/v2/openapi_spec_v2.json) that was present in the reference patch; however, these are auto-generated artifacts produced by CI/bots rather than hand-written code, so their absence does not impact runtime correctness. A minor improvement over the reference is that the agent directly sets required=false in the TOML files, avoiding the intermediate state where the line was removed entirely and then re-added in a subsequent fix commit.
summary: Functionally correct patch that makes merchant_category_code optional in all necessary models and configs, marred only by an unrelated session continuation file and missing auto-generated OpenAPI updates.

missing_requirements.evidence: Reference patch includes updates to api-reference/v1/openapi_spec_v1.json and api-reference/v2/openapi_spec_v2.json removing merchant_category_code from required and adding nullable: true. These are auto-generated artifacts omitted from the agent patch.

improvements_beyond_reference.evidence: Agent directly sets required=false in connector configs, whereas reference patch removed required=true in commit 1/4 and then had to add required=false back in commit 3/4 due to WASM build failures.
